result.summary: Found 1 major layout issue where text elements overlap in the restaurant information line, making content unreadable.

issues.description: In the 'Popular right now' section for Tokumaru Ramen Bar, the delivery time text (25-30) overlaps with the 'Order delivery' text, causing the content to be illegible.
issues.suggestion: Adjust the spacing/alignment of the delivery time and 'Order delivery' text elements to eliminate overlap and ensure full readability.
